findings.description: The bucket is explicitly commented as public with no ACL restricting access, no server-side encryption, no versioning, and no access logging, exposing customer data (an object with sensitive filename 'customer-master.xlsx' is stored here) to unauthorized read/write access.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, meaning data stored in this bucket is not encrypted at rest.
A sensitive file (customer-master.xlsx) is uploaded to the 'data' bucket which is public and unencrypted, directly exposing customer master data to unauthorized access.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for the financials bucket, leaving sensitive financial data unencrypted at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for the operations bucket, leaving data unencrypted at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for the data_science bucket, leaving data unencrypted at rest.
